searchText: Hey <@466102668138512394>, <@531934490826768418> is from the Prysm team and is driving the 8025 effort and has all the context of the project from the last interop devnet we did with prysm and eth-act/lh. He is enquiring around the mock mode for zkboost following the latest middleware re-architecture. He noted that we removed the mock mode from the latest Ethereum package examples. Does this mean zkboost does not support mock mode anymore? (For context <@466102668138512394> is the maintainer of zkboost) New [public and live R2 bucket](https://pub-afa6b160acfb4919bda1d0e2a00b5b77.r2.dev/testnets/sepolia/index.html) of *statelessInputs* for guest programs (Sepolia with Amsterdam activated -- i.e. tests-zkevm@v21.x.x). Keen to see the final form of eip8025 merged to master, including these two PRs - https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5639 - https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5534 Any blockers on them? special recursive proving Keen to see the final form of eip8025
